en: Vintage multi-view postcard with three monochrome photographs from the village of Caoria in a mountainous valley. The top image shows a church with a bell tower labeled "Chiesa" against a backdrop of hills. The lower left image shows a building labeled "Oratorio Curaziale". The lower right image shows a multi‑storey school building labeled "Scuole Elementari". On the right side, large text reads "Saluti da CAORIA".
